retrievalProfile.description: A dramatic low-key portrait with high-contrast split lighting and a right-aligned typographic block featuring heavy slab serifs and sans-serif body text.
excludeWhen: modern minimalist digital aesthetics are preferred

recipe.visualDefinition: A moody, high-contrast portrait where half the subject's face is lost in deep shadow, paired with a structured block of text in the upper right quadrant using bold, vintage-inspired typefaces.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject face emerges from a solid black background
Typographic block is flush-right and vertically stacked
Warm skin tones contrast against a cool or neutral black void
Text hierarchy moves from heavy display to light body text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered or slightly left-of-center, medium close-up scale.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The illuminated eye and cheek of the subject.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the illuminated face, moves right to the bold display text, then down through the body copy.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive solid black negative space surrounding the subject and text.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm peach and amber skin highlights.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Orange or ochre for primary display text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between highlights and shadows.
paletteRestrictions: No bright primary blues or greens

letterConstructionRules: Display text uses ultra-heavy weights with minimal counters
Secondary text uses high-contrast slab serifs
Body text uses clean, wide-set sans-serifs
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase display letters with thick, blocky strokes
Uppercase slab serifs with heavy horizontal bars
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between ultra-heavy lowercase sans and wide uppercase slab serifs.
graphicDevices: Horizontal dividers or slashes between list items

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the heavy, blocky lowercase display feel
Matches the sturdy slab-serif subtitle style
Appropriate for the clean, mid-century body text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a low-key chiaroscuro portrait of a subject with 1960s styling, where the left side of the frame and the left side of the face are completely submerged in deep black shadow. Ensure warm highlights on the right side of the face.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply right-aligned text in the upper right quadrant. Use a very heavy lowercase sans-serif for the top line, a bold uppercase slab-serif in orange for the second line, and a small sans-serif for the list below.

verificationChecks: Is there a clear hierarchy between the three text styles?
Does the lighting create a dramatic split effect on the face?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure shadows are pure black without noise
Verify text does not overlap the subject's features
Check that the orange accent color is muted/retro, not neon
Confirm the lowercase display text is legible despite its weight
recipe.reuseFormula: Chiaroscuro Portrait + Right-Aligned Triple-Tier Typography + 1960s Palette
